compixel.config.title: Configuration
compixel.config.discard_text: Your staged changes have not been saved.
compixel.config.restart_WORLD: Reopen the world for these changes to take effect.
compixel.config.restart_GAME: Restart the game for these changes to take effect.
compixel.config.access_NOT_LOADED: No local configuration file is loaded. Server settings require a local world.
compixel.config.access_REMOTE_SERVER: These settings belong to the connected server and cannot be saved here.
compixel.config.access_LAN_SERVER: World settings are read-only while the world is open to LAN.
compixel.config.access_RELOADED: This configuration was reloaded. Undo / refresh before editing again.
compixel.config.access_UNSUPPORTED: This configuration specification is not supported by this editor.
compixel.config.result_INVALID: This value does not meet the configuration constraints.
compixel.config.result_CONFLICT: The edited value changed elsewhere. Undo / refresh before saving.
compixel.config.result_SAVE_FAILED: Saving failed. Check the log and reload the configuration before continuing.
compixel.config.result_UNKNOWN: This configuration entry is no longer available.
compixel.config.unsupported: This value cannot be edited here.
compixel.config.shared_server: This is the shared server config. Worlds without a separate override use these values.
